revenue_trend.sql: SELECT (invoices."INVOICE_MONTH") AS month, (invoices."SEGMENT") AS segment, (COALESCE((SUM(CASE WHEN (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' THEN (invoices."NET_CENTS") END)), 0)) AS revenue_cents, (COALESCE((SUM(CASE WHEN (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' THEN (invoices."PAID_CENTS") END)), 0)) AS paid_cents, (COALESCE((SUM(CASE WHEN (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' THEN (invoices."OUTSTANDING_CENTS") END)), 0)) AS outstanding_cents, ((COALESCE((SUM(CASE WHEN (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' THEN (invoices."PAID_CENTS") END)), 0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE((SUM(CASE WHEN (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' THEN (invoices."NET_CENTS") END)), 0)), 0)) AS payment_rate FROM DMA_TABLEAU.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES AS invoices LEFT JOIN DMA_TABLEAU.GOLD.DIM_CUSTOMERS AS customers ON (invoices."CUSTOMER_KEY") = (customers."CUSTOMER_KEY") AND (invoices."TENANT_ID") = (customers."TENANT_ID") WHERE (invoices."TENANT_ID") = 'A' AND (invoices."INVOICE_DATE") >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND (invoices."INVOICE_DATE") < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND (invoices."SEGMENT") = 'Unrepresented' AND (invoices."STATUS") = 'posted' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY month, segment
